messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — planning a small config-only deploy to prod at 15:30 UTC. No DB migrations. Rolling canary -> 10% for 10 minutes. Need quick rollback/runbook sign-off :eyes:

Ashwin: I can be primary for rollback. Can someone paste the minimal smoke checklist?

Maria: Smoke checklist (short):
- service health / 2xx rate stays >= 99%
- p95 request latency < 1.2x baseline
- error rate (5m) < 0.5%
- job-queue depth not increasing for 5m
- logs: no new stacktraces containing "KVCache"

Stef: Staging looked clean on the same config patch. Canary metrics baseline uploaded to dashboard: /dash/rollouts/2026-03-config-bump

Jonathan: Won't be online at 15:30. @Ashwin you'll take the rollback actions if thresholds hit?

Ashwin: Yep — I'll watch and execute. Quick rollback snippet for ops if needed:
```
# quick rollback (prod)
kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-api -n prod
# or use release manager
/release rollback 2026-03-17-config-bump
```

deploy-bot: Canary started at 15:30:00 UTC — cohort 10% (id: canary-186999)

Maria: Go/no-go rules: after 5 minutes of canary stability (no threshold breaches) -> proceed to 50% then full. If any of the smoke checks fail at any point -> immediate rollback and open incident channel.

oncall-sre: I'll monitor infra metrics and have access to runbook. Runbook excerpt pasted below for quick reference:
- Step 1: Confirm canary cohort errors on dashboard
- Step 2: If errors breaching -> pause rollout, set traffic to 0% for canary group
- Step 3: Run kubectl rollback (Ashwin)
- Step 4: Postmortem stub created automatically by deploy-bot

Stef: thumbs up from me. Please ping here when you start the 50% phase so QA can spot-check. :thumbsup:

Maria: Thanks all — starting now. Will post status updates every 5m.
